intended_use.summary: Assess the materially new official CPython 3.12.10 Windows embeddable package route. The uv executable and exact 20-wheel closure remain byte-for-byte bound by runtime source gate 001; this gate does not weaken or replace those source findings. Ready permits owner review only.

sources.name: CPython 3.12.10 official Windows 64-bit embeddable package and Sigstore bundle

evidence.note: The official release page identifies the Windows embeddable package for CPython 3.12.10.
The inventory binds filename, 11,133,606-byte metadata identity, official URLs, and Sigstore message digest 4acbed6dd1c744b0376e3b1cf57ce906f9dc9e95e68824584c8099a63025a3c3.
python.org is the Python Software Foundation release surface.
Metadata-only request found public HTTPS availability and Content-Length 11,133,606 with no authentication or terms-acceptance step.
Official documentation publishes the PSF license and incorporated notices for Python 3.12.

criteria.note: License capture remains required during activation.

evidence.note: The official Sigstore bundle binds the exact ZIP digest and transparency-log material.

criteria.note: Downloaded bytes must be reverified before extraction.

evidence.note: Exact byte count, SHA-256, Sigstore URL, and fail-closed verification are fixed.

criteria.note: Metadata identity passes; byte verification is deferred until approval.

evidence.note: Official Windows documentation describes the embeddable package as application-local and almost fully isolated, notes that pip management is not supported, and permits an application installer to provide third-party packages alongside it.
The failed same-version installer route demonstrates why a non-installer application-local artifact is required on this host.

criteria.note: Metadata supports owner review, not runtime fitness; native package loading and fresh-process behavior remain activation gates.

evidence.note: The route uses application-local extraction beneath Active with no registry, PATH, launcher, associations, shortcuts, administrator access, credentials, or system installer transaction.

criteria.note: New executable and native wheel code remain a retained owner-gated risk.

inherited_unchanged_sources.interpretation: These sources and exact wheel identities are unchanged. Their earlier ready assessment remains evidence, while the materially different interpreter artifact and application-local packaging route require this new gate and a new owner decision.

binding_attribution_and_claim_limits: Ready means source metadata is sufficient for an exact owner decision; it does not prove the embedded package can load the locked native wheels.
Synthetic lifecycle success would establish engineering executability only, not benchmark performance or scientific validity.
The prior owner yes applies only to candidate 001 and cannot be carried forward to candidate 002.
